purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-01: Leave Application – Approved
preconditions: Student is authorized; HoD is authorized
action_or_input: Student submits leave application -> HoD reviews and approves application
expected_result: Leave transitions: Draft -> Submitted -> Approved, notifications dispatched

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-02: Leave Application – Rejected
preconditions: Student is authorized; HoD is authorized
action_or_input: Student submits leave application -> HoD reviews and rejects application
expected_result: Leave transitions: Draft -> Submitted -> Rejected, notifications dispatched

purpose: Exercise composite workflow CW-OAP-01: Leave Application Decision branching
preconditions: Two submitted leave applications exist for students
action_or_input: HoD approves first application (BW-OAP-01 path) and rejects second application (BW-OAP-02 path)
expected_result: First application reaches terminal Approved state; second reaches terminal Rejected state

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-03: Bonafide Request – Approved
preconditions: Student is authorized; Academic Administrator is authorized
action_or_input: Student submits bonafide request -> AA verifies request -> AA approves request -> Student downloads certificate
expected_result: Transitions: Submitted -> Verified -> Approved -> Downloaded, notifications dispatched

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-04: Bonafide Request – Rejected
preconditions: Student is authorized; Academic Administrator is authorized
action_or_input: Student submits bonafide request -> AA verifies request -> AA rejects request
expected_result: Transitions: Submitted -> Verified -> Rejected, certificate download unavailable

purpose: Exercise composite workflow CW-OAP-02: Bonafide Request Decision branching
action_or_input: AA approves first request (BW-OAP-03 path) and rejects second request (BW-OAP-04 path)
expected_result: First request produces downloadable certificate; second request terminates with Rejected status

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-05: No-Dues Clearance – Cleared
preconditions: Student is authorized; all seven clearance authorities and AA are authorized
action_or_input: Student initiates no-dues -> all 7 authorities record Clear -> AA finalizes -> Student downloads certificate
expected_result: Transitions: Initiated -> Verification Complete (All Clear) -> Finalized -> Certificate Downloaded

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-06: No-Dues Clearance – Dues Outstanding
preconditions: Student initiates no-dues; six authorities record Clear, one authority records Dues Outstanding
action_or_input: Authority records Dues Outstanding; AA attempts finalization
expected_result: Case enters Verification Complete Dues Outstanding; finalization is blocked until due is cleared

purpose: Exercise composite workflow CW-OAP-03: No-Dues Clearance branching
action_or_input: Case 1 completes all 7 Clear and finalizes (BW-OAP-05); Case 2 has dues outstanding and finalization is blocked (BW-OAP-06)
expected_result: Case 1 reaches Finalized and releases certificate; Case 2 remains unfinalized with dues outstanding

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-07: Assistantship Claim – Approved and Processed
preconditions: PG student has active supervisor assignments; TS, TA, DA, HoD, AA are authorized
action_or_input: Student submits claim -> TS verifies -> TA verifies -> DA forwards -> HoD approves -> AA processes stipend
expected_result: Claim transitions: Submitted -> Supervisor Verified -> Dept Forwarded -> HoD Approved -> Stipend Processed

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-08: Assistantship Claim – Rejected by HoD
preconditions: PG student submits claim; TS and TA verify; DA forwards to HoD
action_or_input: HoD records Reject decision on forwarded claim
expected_result: Claim transitions to Rejected; stipend processing is not available

purpose: Exercise composite workflow CW-OAP-04: Assistantship Claim Processing branching
preconditions: Two assistantship claims are forwarded to HoD
action_or_input: HoD approves claim 1 leading to AA stipend processing; HoD rejects claim 2 terminating the claim
expected_result: Claim 1 completes stipend processing; Claim 2 terminates in Rejected state

purpose: Exercise basis workflow BW-OAP-09: Graduate Seminar Scheduling
preconditions: PG student is authorized; Department Administrator is authorized
action_or_input: PG student requests seminar scheduling -> DA assigns date/time and venue
expected_result: Transitions: Requested -> Scheduled, scheduling history logged, schedule visible to faculty and PG students
